new.prompt: Work Projects4Me issue #{issue} ({project}, repo {repo}) end to end: run /start-issue {issue}, implement it, then /ship-issue {issue}.

in_progress.prompt: Continue Projects4Me issue #{issue} ({project}, repo {repo}). See where it stands (dev-tools/ai/ai issue {issue}, git status on branch claude-issue-{issue} in {repo}; dev-tools/ai/ai start {repo} {issue} if the branch isn't checked out), restart the timer with dev-tools/ai/ai timer {issue}, finish the work, then /ship-issue {issue}.

feedback.prompt: {reviewer} answered on Projects4Me issue #{issue} ({project}, repo {repo}) and assigned it back to you. Read the latest comments (dev-tools/ai/ai issue {issue}), make sure branch claude-issue-{issue} is checked out in {repo} (dev-tools/ai/ai start {repo} {issue} if not), restart the timer with dev-tools/ai/ai timer {issue}, then continue the work and /ship-issue {issue} when it is done.

pending.prompt: The blocker on Projects4Me issue #{issue} ({project}, repo {repo}) should be resolved and {reviewer} assigned it back to you. Read the latest comments (dev-tools/ai/ai issue {issue}), make sure branch claude-issue-{issue} is checked out in {repo} (dev-tools/ai/ai start {repo} {issue} if not), restart the timer with dev-tools/ai/ai timer {issue}, then continue the work and /ship-issue {issue} when it is done.

in_review.prompt: {reviewer} reviewed the PR for Projects4Me issue #{issue} ({project}, repo {repo}) and assigned it back to you. Find the PR number in the issue's comments (dev-tools/ai/ai issue {issue}), restart the timer with dev-tools/ai/ai timer {issue}, then run /address-review {repo} <pr> {issue}.
